property_summary: After any call to NETM by the owner, the owner's balance equals totalDistributed (reference) — the mutant wrongly gives the owner totalSupply for some inputs, so balances(owner) == totalDistributed always holds in reference but not in mutant.
change_summary: Replace assignment to balances[owner] setting it to totalDistributed with setting it to totalSupply (so owner ends up with full supply after NETM).
